# Clinical Consensus

This folder captures established medical agreements and standard guidelines for managing Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) and its treatment-related complications. It currently documents the clinical consensus regarding bone health, specifically the agreement that osteoporosis induced by corticosteroid therapy can be effectively prevented. The content is derived directly from Danish IBD registry reports, providing traceable claims for healthcare standards.

## Pages

- [[clinical-consensus|Clinical Consensus]] — Outlines the general medical agreement that osteoporosis caused by steroid treatment in IBD patients can be prevented, citing specific registry reports.
